post.post_content:
Recognized among the Top 25 Women in the Metaverse, Paige Dansinger is a Metaverse Developer, World-Builder, and Futurist. Having crafted hundreds of worlds in the metaverse, Paige is the visionary founder of Better World Museum, Horizon Art Museum, and Women in Horizon. Awarded for "Most Real World Impact" by XR Women, Paige currently serves as Senior Director of Community and Metaverse Development at Bit Space Development XR. 

Her journey includes roles as a Horizon Worlds Pre-Alpha Creator, Meta Horizon Worlds VR Game Developer in the Meta Creators Program, and participation in the Horizon MiniGame Accelerator and Oculus Launch Pad Program. Recognized globally by Meta as one of the Top 115 Community Leaders through their inaugural Community Leadership Fellowship Program, Paige has presented and participated in distinguished events such as WHO, TEDxMinneapolis, MIT Reality Hackathon, Facebook Connect, Facebook’s Global Wellness & Safety Summit, Nobel Peace Prize, AWE, Immerse Global Summit, Presence Platform Hackathon, Meta Connect, XR for Change, MetaCenter Global Week, and more.
